RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday, March 12, 2018/Phalguna 21, 1939 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Defence; Drinking Water and Sanitation; Earth Sciences;
Environment, Forest and Climate Change; Information and
Broadcasting; Mines; Panchayati Raj; Road Transport and
Highways; Rural Development; Science and Technology;
Shipping; Textiles; Water Resources, River
Development and Ganga Rejuvenation)
Total number of questions — 15
Utilisation of funds collected under
PMKKKY
†*166. SHRI P. L. PUNIA: Will the
Minister of MINES be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the total amount of
funds collected under the Pradhan Mantri
Khanij Kshetra Kalyan Yojana
(PMKKKY) till date;
(b) the details of the amount of funds
allocated to the States, out of the collected
amount of funds, State-wise and the total
amount of funds spent; and
(c) the details of the amount of funds
that was spent in top priority areas?
Solar power based dual pump water
supply scheme in A.P.
*167. SHRI C. M. RAMESH: Will the
Minister of DRINKING W A TER AND
SANITA TION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that solar power
based dual pump water supply scheme is
being implemented in Srikakulam district
of Andhra Pradesh;
(b) the number of habitations in the
district that are expected to get water
supply;
(c) whether it is also a fact that, no
habitation has been covered, since
implementation of the scheme, in 2013;
(d) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(e) by when all the identified habitations
in the above districts would be covered
under the above scheme?
R&D for modernisation of armed
forces
†*168. DR. VINAY P. SAHASRA-
BUDDHE: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) the efforts being made by
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

59
Government towards modernisation of
Indian armed forces;
(b) whether Government is
contemplating for establishing any institute
other than DRDO for technological research
aimed at promoting the modernisation of
armed forces; and
(c) by when India will be self-reliant, in
view of the fact that India is still dependent
on the imports for defence equipments?
Progress of work on NH-43
*169. SHRI RANVIJAY SINGH
JUDEV: Will the Minister of ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the contractor working on
NH-43 from Ambikapur to Pathalgaon and
Pathalgaon to Kunkuri in Chhattisgarh, has
stopped the work;
(b) the amount provided to the
contractor for the said work; and
(c) the progress made on NH-43, till
date and by when the said two works would
be completed?
Construction of new highways
*170. SHRI MANAS RANJAN
BHUNIA:  Will the Minister of ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Ministry has taken
steps to construct new highways in various
States for interconnectivity;
(b) if so, details thereof; and
(c) details of the new highways in the
State of  West Bengal?
Logistic parks/ring roads under
Bharatmala Pariyojana
*171. SHRI DEREK O’BRIEN: Will
the Minister of ROAD TRANSPORT
AND HIGHWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Bharatmala Pariyojana
envisages building of  logistic parks and
ring roads in cities, if so, the details
thereof;
(b) whether these cities also include the
areas under the Smart Cities Mission, and
if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government has
communicated the plan to build such parks
and roads to Urban Local Bodies within
the Smart Cities;
(d) whether Government has consulted
Urban Local Bodies before laying out the
pariyojana in their cities, if so, the details
thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Working capital for HSL
*172. SHRI V . VIJAYASAI REDDY:
Will the Minister of  DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Prime
Minister has assured of giving ` 20,000
crores as working capital to Hindustan
Shipyard Limited (HSL) in 2014, as part
of  Make in India initiative;
(b) the reasons as to why the Ministry
is not pursuing the assurance in spite of
the fact that HSL is struggling to get working
capital and looking for Central assistances
whenever it gets any new order; and
(c) whether the Ministry has entered
into agreements with Japan and South Korea

60
for buying ships, instead of giving orders
for construction of ships to HSL?
Development of Azhikkal port in
Kannur
*173. SHRI K. K. RAGESH: Will the
Minister of  SHIPPING be pleased to state:
(a) whether the development of the
Azhikkal port, Kannur, is being considered
for approval under the Sagarmala scheme;
(b) if so, whether any time-frame has
been kept to give official approval; and
(c) the reasons, if any, for delay in
approval?
Adverse environmental impact of
disposable plastic cups
†*174. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of ENVIRONMENT,
FOREST AND CLIMATE CHANGE be
pleased to state:
(a) estimated number of disposable
plastic cups used every year across the
country;
(b) whether these used disposable
plastic cups have adverse impact on

Total number of questions — 160
JV A for procurement of
Rafale aircraft
1761. SHRI VIVEK K. TANKHA: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Joint Venture
Agreement (JV A) regarding Refale Jet was
signed between its developer, Dassault
Aviation, and Hindustan Aeronautics
Limited, and was subsequently annulled;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the
earlier clause for manufacturer outsourcing
50 per cent of the total deal amount from
an Indian PSU has been removed in the
new JVA; and
(c) if so, the reasons for recall of the
JV A with a PSU and reasons for signing
the agreement with a private company i.e.
Reliance Defence Ltd. which has no
experience in defence sector?
Empanelment of hospitals for ECHS 
facilities
# 1762. SHRI RAJEEV 
CHANDR A-SEKHAR: Will the Minister 
of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has taken steps 
to re-enroll/re-empanel the 169 hospitals 
that have withdrawn Ex-Servicemen 
Contribution of Health Scheme (EC HS) 
facilities;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(d) steps taken by Government to ensure
that the ECHS empanelled hospitals’
capacity for veterans across the country is
being maintained adequately for complete
access to good medical facilities?
413
(# CANCELLED)

Grant of pay parity and NFU
# 1763. SHRI RAJEEV 
CHANDRA-SEKHAR: Will the Minister 
of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has moved for 
stay on the Armed Forces Tribunal order 
granting pay parity and Non-Functional 
Upgradation (NFU) to Defence personnel 
in the Supreme Court; and
(b) if so, the reasons therefor?
Budget allocation for armed forces
1764. SHRI A.U. SINGH DEO: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be please to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the budget
allocation for Defence has been
significantly reduced and is the lowest since
1962;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor;
(c) whether Government has done any
study to replenish and modernise the armed
forces, if so, details thereof and if not,
reasons therefor; and
(d) whether the low budget allocation
will hinder the Government's efforts to
modernise the armed forces, thereby
causing national security concerns, if so,
details thereof?
Shortage of arms in Army
†1765. SHRI NARESH AGRAW AL:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the shortage
of arms in Indian Army has not been met;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(c) if not, the countries with which
treaties have been signed to meet the
shortage of arms during the last three years
and the arms received therefrom?
Transfer of technology in Rafale deal
1766. SHRI RAVI PRAKASH
VERMA:
SHRI NEERAJ SHEKHAR:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether transfer of technology
under Rafale aircraft deal would be done
by France;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) if not, the reasons for compromising
the deal; and
(d) the cost of each aircraft as per the
deal?
Privatization of defence production
1767. SHRI NEERAJ SHEKHAR:
SHRI RAVI PRAKASH
VERMA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is
contemplating to privatise defence
production in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government has withdrawn
the public investments and is
contemplating to allow foreign companies
in defence production;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the reasons for compromising the
national security?
(# CANCELLED)

Strategic Partnership Model in
Defence Acquisition
1768. SHRI C.M. RAMESH: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Defence
Acquisition Council has recently cleared
the Strategic Partnership Model (SPM);
(b) if so, to what extent SPM will help
in quickening the Defence procurement;
(c) when the SPM would go before the
Cabinet Committee on Security for its
approval;
(d) whether SPM is different from the
existing Defence Procurement Procedure
2016;
(e) if not, whether they will contradict
each other; and
(f) how SPM will push 'Make in India'
initiative and the amount of investment and
employment opportunities it is likely to
create?
